business_problem: boxxe needed to detect and respond to faster-moving cyber threats across diverse customer environments without overloading its security analysts or relying on fragmented dashboards and manual reporting.
solution_summary: boxxe modernized its security-operations workflow with IBM Security QRadar SIEM on Cloud and IBM Security QRadar SOAR. QRadar's user behavior analytics applies machine learning to identify abnormal login behavior and other threats earlier than boxxe's prior manual rules, while SOAR and the unified analyst experience help analysts investigate, cross-reference, escalate, and threat-hunt from a smaller set of consolidated dashboards. The team deployed UBA in a multitenant architecture and activated more than 1,500 rules, allowing the platform to learn in the background and tune detection thresholds with minimal analyst input. QRadar's federated search also reaches into external platforms and returns filtered results into one pane of glass, which helped boxxe shrink 14 dashboards to three with a goal of one. That architecture gives the SOC broader visibility, faster detection, and lower operational overhead across managed customer environments.

solution_components.name: IBM Security QRadar SIEM
solution_components.role: Collects and analyzes security telemetry, applies UBA, and provides the federated investigation experience used by boxxe's SOC.

solution_components.name: IBM Security QRadar SOAR
solution_components.role: Coordinates response and automation workflows so the SOC can mitigate threats more quickly.

data_flow: Security telemetry from customer systems is ingested into QRadar SIEM, where UBA and machine-learning analytics score risky behavior, federated search brings in context from other platforms, and QRadar SOAR helps analysts escalate and remediate threats from the same operating environment.
business_outcome: boxxe reduced response times, cut manual reporting work, consolidated analyst tooling, and improved its ability to detect and mitigate sophisticated threats across customer environments.
